text: Helm, Nov. 13 — Peverell Semiconductors laid off 1,200 staff this week as it retools production for a narrower line of industrial chips, people familiar with the matter said. The cuts, announced internally on Tuesday, affect employees across the company’s Helm fabrication campus and its design office in Rellan, the people said. Chief executive Mara Venn told managers the move was needed to “restore operating discipline” after two quarters of weaker orders from equipment makers and auto suppliers. Severance packages will include 10 weeks of pay and continued health coverage through January, according to the people. Peverell had roughly 8,700 employees before the reductions, they said.
